messages:
Sam (People Ops): Hey team :wave: Quick heads-up — we need to collect SOC2/ISO artifacts next week. To avoid one-day meltdowns, we're running a staggered upload plan (team lanes + lightweight QA). Please follow the schedule below and upload artifacts to the compliance S3 bucket: https://internal.redwood/corp-compliance. Use the naming convention exactly so automated ingestion works. If you have fewer than 5 artifacts you can move to the next available slot but still mark an owner.

Schedule (UTC):
- Mon 2026-04-06: Platform, Infra, Runtime
- Tue 2026-04-07: Finance, Legal, Procurement
- Wed 2026-04-08: Eng Services, SDKs, DevEx
- Thu 2026-04-09: Security, SRE, Observability
- Fri 2026-04-10: ML, Data, Research

Naming convention (exact):
```
<team>-<owner>-<YYYYMMDD>-<artifact-type>-<short-desc>.pdf
example: platform-aurora-20260406-architecture-diagram.pdf
```
Retention tag: SOC2-2026. If a doc contains PII redact and attach a redaction-log.txt.

If you need an exception (contractor timelines, large exports) open the exceptions form: https://internal.redwood/compliance-exceptions (we've built a 48-hour exception window only for contractors). Final fallback deadline for all uploads: 2026-04-12 23:59 UTC.

Ian (Security): Quick request — please include a 1-line README.md inside each team folder stating what the artifact is and who owns verification. Security will sample-check ~15% of folders. Also prefer hyphens in filenames (no underscores).

Elena (Finance): Noted. Finance will upload vendor invoices, cost reconciliations, and the procurement approvals on Tue. Who should I tag for verification?

Sam (People Ops): Tag @Elena (Finance) for finance checks and tag @Ian (Security) for security spot-checks. We'll maintain an upload tracker; owners get pinged on missing items.

Alice (Platform): Platform will rate-limit uploads from CI to prevent S3 throttling — please keep artifact sizes under 50MB where possible or provide a download pointer rather than direct binary. We'll handle the CI schedule so your lane doesn't collide.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled — compliance upload deadline (first lane): 2026-04-06T23:59:00Z. Automated follow-ups will post in each team channel at the start of their assigned day.

Elena (Finance): Will there be a central QA step? We can do a quick checksum & meta review if you want.

Sam (People Ops): Yes — Finance + Security do lightweight QA (checks: naming, README, redaction present if needed). If issues found, we open a ticket in #help-compliance. The goal is to close 90% of lanes without rework.

Ian (Security): One more: please avoid screenshots of logs with IPs or tokens; if you must include logs, scrub sensitive fields and add a scrub-report.txt.

Alex (CEO): Thanks for organizing, Sam. Please escalate any blockers to me directly if you see a team falling behind — we need this in for the ISO calendar. :thumbsup:

Sam (People Ops): Appreciate it — I'll post the tracker link and a short checklist per lane by EOD. Ping me here for any lane swaps. :white_check_mark:
